resolution.note: test/task/pending-records.test.ts: publish --dry-run drops a pending record the base closed and keeps one edited after publication; fails on old code, passes now

title: Task publish would revert a record that a lane PR already published and closed
body:
On 2026-11-17 the lead created t-7n4hhgr with krn task create (held on refs/krn/pending-tasks), then a lane PR (#1306) carried and closed the record. krn task publish --dry-run still listed t-7n4hhgr: stillPending (src/task/pending.ts) treats any pending blob that differs from the published one as an edit, so publish would write the older open record over the closed one.
Outcome: krn task publish --dry-run prints no id for a pending record that a later base commit published and closed, and still prints the id of an edit made after publication (pass/fail in one test).
Proof: node --test on a test/task publish test with both fixtures exits 0.
